introHtml: Gray multi function tools offer a professional, understated look that fits seamlessly into corporate gift bags, safety kits, or trade show giveaways. Unlike brighter colors, gray conveys reliability and neutrality, making these tools suitable for any industry. Choose from stainless steel tools with gray handles or coated finishes, and add your logo via laser engraving or pad printing for a clean, durable mark.
